title: Required Documents for SASSA Grant Appeal
description: Complete checklist of documents you need to submit a successful SASSA grant appeal, including certification requirements and where to upload them.

seo.metaTitle: Required Documents for SASSA Grant Appeal — Complete Checklist
seo.metaDescription: Complete document checklist for SASSA grant appeals: certified ID, 3 months bank statements, unemployment affidavit, UIF and NSFAS letters. What you need and how to submit.

contentBlocks.text: Required Documents for SASSA Grant Appeal
Submitting the correct documents with your appeal is critical. Missing or incorrect documents are the most common reason for appeal delays or dismissals.

steps.title: Gather all documents
steps.description: Gather all required documents before starting your appeal submission.

steps.title: Get them certified
steps.description: Ensure all documents are certified (stamped by SAPS or a commissioner of oaths).

steps.title: Upload clear copies
steps.description: Upload clear scanned copies or photos of each document on the ITSAA portal.

steps.title: Keep originals safe
steps.description: Keep original copies in a safe place — you may need them for a follow-up office visit.

documents.label: Certified copy of your 13-digit South African ID (front and back)
Latest 3 months bank statements showing all deposits and withdrawals
Unemployment affidavit sworn at a SAPS station
UIF de-registration letter (UI-19 form) if applicable
NSFAS cancellation or completion letter if applicable
Medical report (for disability grant appeals only)
Proof of address (utility bill or tribal authority letter)

contentBlocks.title: Important Notes
contentBlocks.text: Submit documents within 90 days of the decline letter. Certification must be dated within the last 6 months. Documents not certified or with expired certification will not be accepted.

faqs.question: Can I upload documents after submitting my appeal?
faqs.answer: Yes. The ITSAA portal allows you to upload additional documents after submission. Look for the 'Upload Documents' option on your appeal dashboard.

faqs.question: Do I need a lawyer to prepare appeal documents?
faqs.answer: No. SASSA appeals are designed to be submitted without legal representation. The forms are straightforward and designed for self-representation.
